title.zh: 将南三宝颜省Mahayag市镇Mahayag社区医院由10张床位的社区医院扩建升级为25张床位的区医院，名称为Mahayag区医院，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Expanding and Upgrading the Mahayag Community Hospital in the Municipality of Mahayag, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, From A Ten-bed Capacity Community Hospital Into A Twenty-five-bed Capacity District Hospital, To Be Known As the Mahayag District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Mahayag Community Hospital in the Municipality of Mahayag, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, is hereby expanded and upgraded from a ten-bed capacity community hospital into a twenty-five-bed capacity district hospital, to be known as the Mahayag District Hospital.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
